state.target_treatment: Tyr-targeted CRISPR/Cas9 zygote treatment versus replication of a defined, heritable mutant genotype.
state.scope: The hybrid (B6CBAF1/J x FVB/NJ) founder cohort: albino mouse #30 illustrates within-founder allele diversity; the germline question concerns the hybrid pigmentation mosaics. The C57BL/6N test crosses are retained as a contrasting cohort, not transferred to the hybrids.

evidence.location: Methods: RNA injections into mouse zygotes; Tyr mutation analysis. Results: Characterization of CRISPR/Cas9-induced Tyr mutations
evidence.text: Tyr4a, Tyr4b, and Cas9 RNAs were introduced into zygotes. Tail-DNA analysis identified multiple mutant alleles in completely albino hybrid founder #30. The authors attribute the within-founder diversity to mosaicism, potentially arising from editing that persisted into cleavage stages. Deep sequencing reported 57 mutant alleles meeting its read-frequency threshold across 23 hybrid founders; these are not 57 injected animals.

evidence.location: Results: Germ line transmission of targeted Tyr alleles. Discussion: paragraph beginning Complete albinism and pigmentation mosaicism
evidence.text: C57BL/6N mosaics produced albino progeny in crosses with albino mates. The hybrid pigmentation mosaics were not tested this way: they already carried the FVB/NJ albino allele, which could produce albino offspring without demonstrating transmission of a newly induced allele. Somatic evidence and the C57BL/6N crosses do not establish new-allele transmission for those untested hybrids.

records.record_origin: Source Results and Methods, as archived in NCBI BioC XML; published aggregate counts, not a new sequence reanalysis or unique-origin count. The value 5 for founder #30 is the author-manuscript prose report; publisher Figure 3C lists six allele entries. The exact total remains unresolved.

criteria.uniform_one_allele_pair: All sampled cells can be represented by one common pair of Tyr alleles; albinism establishes a uniform mutant genotype.
criteria.within_founder_mosaicism: Different mutant alleles occur within the same founder, so complete albinism does not establish one uniform mutant genotype.
criteria.one_founder_per_allele: Each reported allele comes from a different injected animal; the animal identifier combines those founders.

criteria.unique_new_allele_marker: Albinism uniquely marks the newly induced allele because the hybrid parents carry no prior albino allele.
criteria.no_germline_possible: The hybrid founders are established to lack germ cells, making transmission biologically impossible.
criteria.all_hybrid_alleles_verified: Allele-specific progeny sequencing already establishes transmission of every newly induced hybrid-founder allele.
